attributionNote: Recorded in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library under Augustus Hopkins Strong (1836-1921). description: Systematic Theology: The Doctrine of Man (Volume II) — the English text the Christian Classics Ethereal Library publishes for this work. The record was created by the CCEL import from the site's own catalogue and plain text; an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's catalogue, whose shelves follow the site's own division of Christian literature, and whose transcription follows the print edition Philadelphia: Judson Press, 1907.
availabilityNote: Complete in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's plain-text edition: 1 chapter(s), 418 paragraph(s), 1,672 words. The divisions are the headings of the site's own text, which the library stores rather than asking the site for again when the work is read. The text is public domain and is displayed with the library's credit.
